scope: Read-only semantic review of a separate Muse code37 follow-up evidence package. No device, Muse, USB, network, account or deployment actions were performed by this reviewer. No package scripts were executed.

artifact.integrity: Maintainer read Muse completion message, copied the completed archive over existing SSH, checked announced size/SHA and extracted with bounded ZIP validation and CRC. No contained script was executed.
artifact.retained_transfer_failure: A first copy made while Muse was still uploading had no ZIP directory and was rejected. Only the later complete archive with the announced SHA was reviewed.

authorization_and_intervention.source: Maintainer observed the Muse conversation and delivered the existing owner authorization for these three current first-use agreements at 14:12 CST. Muse performed the phone task through its existing pairing; no reviewer used USB to substitute for task actions.
authorization_and_intervention.delegated_identity: Run is reported as assistant-delegated testing, not owner-hand execution.
authorization_and_intervention.recovery_actor: The Back operations described as manual in RUNLOG are present as Muse-issued Airtap CLI commands and actual accepted response receipts. They are deliberate agent recovery actions, not evidence of a human or USB performing the task.
authorization_and_intervention.maintainer_actions_during_run: RUNLOG reports none; available command logs show no maintenance installation or re-pairing. Evidence acquisition and this review are maintainer activities after the run.
authorization_and_intervention.outside_scope: No identity verification, account login/registration, posting, messaging or account changes are evidenced as performed. This is not proof of those capabilities.

limits: WPS exposes no document body in its four-node accessibility tree; visible text was inspected in the screenshot. This is semantic display verification, not a WPS export byte-for-byte round trip.
The screenshot, not the truncated body node alone, supports routes 1 through 8. Route 9 is partly covered; routes 10 through 17 were not observed. No full-article or all-account-mode claim.

douyin.blocker: An unrelated local-network permission prompt remained unchanged after two accepted deny-tap receipts. A deliberate Back dismissed it and list browsing resumed. The attempted detail tap reported fresh_observation_required; no opened detail is evidenced.
limits: Accepted tap is not proof that a protected dialog accepted the action. Platform input protection is a plausible explanation, not a verified root cause.
No Allow action is recorded; final OS permission state was not independently read, so report no grant action rather than a proven permission-bit denial.
There is no observed detail screen or full video/article content.
An initial mistaken toolbar tap was followed by Back and creation from the list; this recovery is preserved.
One list-tree output was overwritten by a later observe in the same log sequence. Use the separately retained list-tree-after-save file; do not count the overwritten file as tree evidence.
The stored note contains Muse’s account of permission denial; that narrative is not an independent OS permission-state check.

continuity_and_finish.original_pair_scope: The logs name the original configuration and first/final receipts retain the same connection identifier and increasing sequence. Credentials and claim identity are intentionally absent, so the package alone is not a cryptographic comparison with the prior run.
continuity_and_finish.audio_limit: Music volume is zero, but its muted flag is false. Ring/notification/system have muted=true and volume zero. No volume mutation command appears in supplied logs; endpoint checks do not prove continuous acoustic silence.

failures_retained.unknown_outcomes: Two gesture_interrupted_outcome_unknown receipts are retained. Subsequent observations support that the intended UI transitions occurred; they are not relabeled as ordinary successful tap receipts.
documentation_corrections: RUNLOG prose omits distinct window_metadata_unavailable and two not_foreground failures; retain the complete raw error histogram.
RUNLOG original-directory item/byte counts differ from the extracted sanitized package. Use the parent-verified package inventory and this review’s actual file counts.
Do not call deliberate Muse-issued Back operations maintainer manual intervention.

publication_boundary: Raw images, private output paths, connection/window identifiers and the raw package are not publication material. Publish only a separately reviewed minimal summary.
This summary omits private domains, connection identifiers, account names, public-content authors and phone UI images. It does not certify all raw files free of private data.
This code37 follow-up does not verify the new code38 notification/onboarding/TLS changes, iOS/other devices, independent first-user setup, a new long-idle run or all-app support.
